# bumble:futurespace

> Coding & robotics courses for kids 8–14 using the mbot platform. Hands-on programming, real hardware, small groups. Powered by bumble:education.

## What We Offer

- **Robot Explorer** — Beginner course (ages 8–10), block coding, 8 weeks, €25
- **Code the Machine** — Intermediate course (ages 11–14), Python, 10 weeks, €40
- Kids build and code a real mbot robot — no screen simulations
- Small groups, personal attention, no experience needed

## Quick Facts

- **Age group:** 8–14 years
- **Platform:** mbot (Makeblock)
- **Languages:** German, English
- **Location:** Munich, Germany
- **Price:** €25–€40 per course
- **Run by:** bumble:education (part of bumbleflies)
